verdict.rationale: Granola is a cloud SaaS meeting-notes product with no evidence of any self-hostable core, on-premise deployment option, or open-source release; all documentation describes a hosted API, MCP, chat, and integration features rather than a self-hostable core. This is an applicable axis (a buyer could ask whether an AI-native tool can be self-hosted) but no evidence supports it, and one community comment even notes local-only storage is a workaround via a third-party app, not a self-hosting option for Granola itself.
